title: Luca great Timeless Barcelona Guide
text: Fun walking tour around primarily the Gothic area, Jewish quarter, and El Borne. Our guide Luca was very knowledgeable, funny, and kept a fast pace. He was very open to questions and provided suggestions for restaurants and shopping areas. He spoke great English but spoke so quickly that non fluent English speakers may have a hard time understanding.
author: Paterjo

title: The best way to discover Barcelona!
text:
I am picky when it comes to choosing tour guides, and I did quite a bit of research before deciding on this one. I can confidently say I made the right choice!

Luca is incredibly knowledgeable, funny and engaging. He has a way of bringing history to life and making even the smallest details interesting. We walked past several other tour groups along the way, and I noticed that they didn’t look nearly as entertained as we were!!!

If you want to learn about the history of Barcelona and Catalunya while having a great time, this is the tour to book. Luca is fantastic and I can’t recommend him en
author: Fabiola_V

title: Must do tour of Barcelona
text: Brilliant walking tour. Super informative. Luca (our guide) was extremely knowledgeable about all things Barcelona, Spain and Europe as well as being highly entertaining. Thoroughly recommend doing the tour.
author: Tony_J

title: Recommended!
text: Our guide Luca was knowledgeable, passionate - a man from Napoli in Barcelona?! - and entertaining. A nice mix of history, facts and anecdotes. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: voconnor99

title: Personalized experience
text: Extensive and informative. Lucas was chock full pf.info and anecdotes. History was fun and cohesive.
author: Alan_R

title: Great tour to enjoy & learn.
text: Very informative & interesting tour around the different areas of Barcelona.  Short stops at each point but lots of information and opportunities to ask questions. Luca is a very knowledgeable,  personable & enthusiastic guy, we had a great time with him and he made the tour really enjoyable. Highly recommend.
author: Robbie_M

title: Fantastic tour of Barcelona's layers of history! Excellent guide (thank you, Luca!)
text: Fantastic tour of the historical sites and Gothic quarter of Barcelona. Absolutely recommend this tour for anyone interested in a deeper look at Barcelona - past and present. Luca was an outstanding guide - knowledgeable , energetic. And very helpful - and entertaining! We loved the deeper look at Barcelona 's history - Roman, medieval, gothic, industrial and modern. We loved the descriptions of art, architecture, history and culture. Thank you, Luca!
author: Rina_H

title: Learn A lot in a Short Time
text: What a great primer on the gothic quarter of Barcelona. Luca did a fantastic job about explaining the history of the quarter as well as Barcelona at large. His explanations were peppered with just the right amount of humor to keep history interesting. We learned of some important facts which we wouldn’t have discovered on our own. Pacing was leisurely and we could digest the information easily. I highly recommend for anyone wanting to get an informed perspective on the quarter and its history.
author: Manuel_P

title: Luca is an incredibly...
text: Luca is an incredibly nice and knowledgeable person and this tour was definitely one of the highlights of my trip!! 100% recommend
author: Rod_T

title: Walking tour of Barcelona.
text: Luca was an excellent guide who explained the complicated history of Barcelona.  Highly recommend the tour.  We have been on many walking tours and this rates at the top.
